summary: Email notification feature testing completed. All 15 backend API tests passed. Frontend Settings page with email configuration UI verified working. Resend integration implemented with placeholder API key (RESEND_ENABLED=false by default).

ui_bugs.issue: Custom toggle component has pointer event interception issue when clicking directly on the toggle div
ui_bugs.workaround: Click on the label text instead of the toggle, or use force=True

passed_tests: GET /api/admin/email/settings - returns config status with all required fields
PUT /api/admin/email/settings - can disable specific email types
POST /api/admin/email/test - returns not_configured when API key is placeholder
POST /api/leads - triggers lead_alert email and stores status in DB
GET /api/admin/email/status/booking/{id} - returns email status for booking
GET /api/admin/email/status/lead/{id} - returns email status for lead
GET /api/admin/email/status/invalid/{id} - returns 400 for invalid entity type
Email idempotency - lead_alert email tracking works correctly
critical_code_review_comments: Email service properly implements idempotency via DB tracking (emails.{type}.sent_at)
Background tasks used for async email sending (BackgroundTasks)
Email templates are well-formatted with Fairy Star branding
All 5 email types implemented: booking_confirmation, new_booking_alert, coordinator_assigned, lead_alert, service_alert
Settings UI shows clear configuration status and instructions for adding Resend API key
seed_data_creation: Test leads and service requests created with TEST_ prefix during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Email notification feature fully tested. All API endpoints working correctly. Resend integration uses placeholder API key - actual email delivery requires real Resend API key. Email status tracking in DB working for idempotency. Settings UI shows configuration status and allows toggling email types on/off.

email_settings_api.GET /api/admin/email/settings: Returns enabled, resend_configured, resend_from, admin_email, test_mode, and all 5 email type toggles

email_test_api.POST /api/admin/email/test: Sends test email (returns not_configured with placeholder key)

email_status_api.GET /api/admin/email/status/{type}/{id}: Returns email sending status for booking, lead, service_request

email_resend_api.POST /api/admin/email/resend/{type}/{id}: Resets email flag and queues resend

email_triggers.lead_creation: Triggers lead_alert email via background task
email_triggers.coordinator_assignment: Triggers coordinator_assigned email via background task
email_triggers.service_request: Triggers service_alert email via background task

verified_features.email_idempotency: Email status tracked in DB (emails.{type}.sent_at) to prevent duplicates
verified_features.settings_ui: Shows API key status, from address, test mode, master toggle, 5 email type toggles, test email input, configuration instructions
